meta.description: Guide teams through MITRE's Problem Framing Canvas. Use when you need a clearer problem statement before jumping to solutions.

copy.tagline_en: Guide teams to clarify problem statements using a structured canvas
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team often goes in the wrong direction due to unclear problem definition

howto.what: 引导你通过MITRE问题框架画布的三个阶段（向内看、向外看、重新定义），提出结构化问题，最终生成清晰的问题陈述和“How Might We”行动问题。
howto.when: 当你需要澄清一个模糊的问题、挑战已有假设或避免过早跳入解决方案时触发。

say.text: 帮我用问题框架画布分析移动端留存问题。
say.note: 启动画布流程，从向内看阶段开始。

say.text: 重新定义这个利益相关者需求，我们还没开始构建。
say.note: 用于在构建前重新审视问题。

howto.what_en: Guides you through MITRE's Problem Framing Canvas in three phases (Look Inward, Look Outward, Reframe), asking structured questions to produce a clear problem statement and a "How Might We" question.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to clarify a messy problem, challenge assumptions, or avoid jumping to solutions prematurely.

say_en.text: Run a Problem Framing Canvas for our mobile retention issue.
say_en.note: Starts the canvas process from Look Inward phase.

say_en.text: Help me reframe this stakeholder request before we build anything.
